extension.summary: Opens Plex, and hands the TV back to Couch when Plex closes
extension.description: Part of Couch (https://github.com/alecschoen/couch). Kodi here is only a way to run Plex: this starts Plex as Kodi comes up and quits Kodi when Plex exits or is minimised, so the Couch launcher comes back.
